## Description

Asymptotic covariance matrix of the half-vectorization
of the sample covariance matrix in R [@RCoreTeam-2026]
without a distributional assumption
(asymptotic distribution free):
the consistent estimator and its unbiased version.
The functions are internal; other projects can copy them.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `gammaADF` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ijapesigan/gammaADF) with:

```r
if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/gammaADF")
```

## More Information

See
[GitHub Pages](https://ijapesigan.github.io/gammaADF)
for package documentation.
